notes.title: Guideline of Newly Changed Weapon Control
notes.content:
Hello all, 
Please check the below information to use the newly changed weapon control!

[b]1. Subdivided weapon control into specific parts and more realistic and technical action will be delivered. [/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1IS3yJ3.png[/img]

[b]2. Refined the modelling and magazine and bolt can be controlled separately.[/b]
[list]
[*] All magazines and bolts are at separate controls.
[*] A partial automatic option is available for novice players.
[*] Faster weapon control option is available for experienced players.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U3qmmfM.png[/img]

[b]3. Magazine loaded with or without ammunition can be distinguished as well as the numbers of ammunition loaded in chamber.[/b]
[list]
[*] A chamber is a hole where ammunition is loaded and fired.
[*] ‘1’ ammunition is saved in a fully loaded chamber.
[*] Bolt control is must when reloading after all ammunition are consumed.
[*] Bolt control is NOT necessary when replacing reusable magazine for consecutive shooting without Bolt Action. 
[*] This is what we call 'Technical Reload' function.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5OWvnbn.png[/img]

[b]4. Use of magazine is handy at player’s waist pouch.[/b]
[list]
[*] Mask function is available like as weapon when in active control mode.
[*] A pouch gleams within controlling distance. 
[*] Magazine suitable for each type of weapon can be attained. 
[*] All ammunition accidentally disassembled or left in loss of magazine will be restored back in a pouch.  
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fsmveUf.png[/img]

[b]5. Animation (of hand), weapon sound and control vary by type of weapon.[/b]
[list]
[*] Animation per form of weapon and magazine (e.g. SMG, AR, SR, Pistol) is newly added. 
[*] Each weapon has its own controls and the players must be fully acquainted with it. 
Ex) P90’s magazine must be disassembled and assembled above the barrel whereas Venelli must be loaded once with a pouch ammunition. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uCxK1oG.png[/img]

[b]6. Additional options are available for both novice-manual players and unwanted manual players.[/b]
[list]
[*] Options will be the same for an auxiliary hand’s weapon pulverization function for shooting and left-hand preferred players. 
[*] Auto and manual weapon control options are additionally provided.  
[*] Auto players can control weapons without an auxiliary hand. 
[*] Manual players can control Bolt Action, Technical Reload for the magazine disassembly & assembly and more. 
[*] Manual players can use weapons much faster and accurately than auto players at great exhaustion and proficiency. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U2YtEom.png[/img]

[b]7. A mask will guide firearm (parts) that is controlled by an auxiliary hand.[/b]
[list]
[*] Partial firearms hold various functions in specific parts.
[*] An auxiliary hand in place will guide firearm (parts) for a smooth play.  
[*] Highlights, such as the barrel pulverization, bolt, magazine and more can be detected. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9kmQLao.png[/img]

[b]8. A mask will guide firearm (parts) that is currently in need of control.[/b]
[list]
[*] Firearms in need of control will be guided depending on the situation for unexperienced or novice-auto players. 
[*] Bolt Action post magazine assembly is required when running out of ammunition or in need of magazine disassembly.  
[*] This function is applied to all weapons separately and easy to use for all players. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Afnf7BE.png[/img]

[b]9. Technical Reload Action is available. [/b]
[list]
[*] When ammunition is left in loaded breech, consecutive shooting is available by quick 
magazine assembly without Bolt Action.
[*] When ammunition is consumed in loaded magazine, Bolt Action is required after 
assembling new magazine.
[*] Technical Reload function is activated when the magazine is disassembled and assembled 
with some ammunition left but only when loaded in breech.
[*] Extra assembled magazine can be used right after consuming the very last 1 ammunition
in loaded breech.
[*] For 1 ammunition and extra 30 magazines, total of 31 ammunition are available under 
Technical Reload option.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/irQu1SP.png[/img]

[b]10. Consecutive shooting is available with Technical Reload Action without Bold Action.[/b]

[b]11. Magazine can be removed with a track pad button on the bottom without an auxiliary hand.[/b]
[list]
[*] Smooth detach capability is added over magazine removal by hand. 
[*] Assembled magazine will be detached through a track pad button on the bottom. 
[*] Skilled players can disassemble and assemble the magazine simultaneously with a track pad button. 
[/list]

[b]12. Breech Check and Bolt Action have been reinforced to avoid unnecessary leaking ammunition.[/b]
[list]
[*] Bolt Action is an action of pulling the breech block and putting back in place. New ammunitions are loaded over empty shells. 
[*] Bolt Action will prevent a leak of ammunition through frequent breech check.  
[/list]

[b]13. Sound effect varies by magazine removal, assembly and slide action.[/b]
[list]
[*] Manual players can subdivide the action and sound according to manually controlled weapons. 
[/list]

[b]14. Subdivided SR Bolt Action is available.[/b]
[list]
[*] Bolt Action for SR is superior over other type of weapons.
[*] A current SR undergoes ‘4’ phases of Bolt Action as an AWM type. 
[*] Faster yet concise skills are required: pulling up > pulling backward > pulling forward> pulling down. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mELFTkO.png[/img]

[b]15. SR Bolt Action is available only after firing.[/b]
[list]
[*] SR with a large-caliber bullet must take Bolt Action after firing.
[*] AR without rapid or regular rifle function can have additional shooting after firing and then 
taking Bolt Action.
[/list]

Hope you guys enjoy playing our game. 
If you have any questions, please leave comments. 
Cheers,

notes.title: The Build Update Required
notes.content:
Hello guys!

SPECIAL FORCE VR: INFINITY WAR supports the matchmaking between
the same version of builds because of the stability of gameplay.

Users who do not update will not have any issues on a single play, 
but there may have difficulty in matchmaking.

We recommend to update the build!

Thank you for your understanding and support. 
Cheers,

Cheers,
